meta.scope: Courses the Faculty of Science lists as electives with no prerequisites, three from a student's own list, and the Anthropology and Geography electives from the HSS pages. Titles and course codes were checked against the 2026-27 calendar.
caveats: Credit hours are assumed to be 3. The sources do not state them (the calendar says 3 is normal).
Offerings, instructors and terms for electives are NOT loaded, except where added in data/offerings_extra.csv.

COMP 1400, 1401 and 2000 appear on the Science list but the 2026-27 calendar marks them inactive, so they are left out. EASC 2918 (Earth's Story) is also left out: the calendar marks it inactive, although the Earth Sciences department page still lists it.
The Science electives page is out of date in places (it used ERSC for Earth Sciences, whose code is EASC, and it had STAT 2500 wrong). The calendar wins.
Prerequisites for the Science electives were read from calendar excerpts, not every full entry. Entries flagged needs_review say what was not confirmed.

Anthropology and Geography electives (first and second year) come from the HSS electives pages, and the calendar excerpts agree with them. The HSS Anthropology page shows no prerequisites, though the faculty says electives have 0 or 1. Other HSS departments are not loaded yet.
